cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your shelf fell because they supplied the wrong bracket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You fitted it upside down. Look at the arrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. That's a misleading arrow. We should photograph it for the manufacturer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You drew that arrow. I watched you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because theirs was missing. Put that in the complaint; they made us supply our own safety markings.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 evidence of A's involvement into a new complaint item.

specificity.evidence: A1 fallen shelf and B2 bracket arrow establish the concrete installation problem.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 made us supply safety markings is an earned inversion of B4 accusation.
